intro: Converting kilometers per hour (km/h) to meters per second (m/s) is essential when translating measurements across automotive speedometer readings, aviation airspeed logs, maritime navigation, and meteorological wind reports. One kilometers per hour equals 0.27778 meters per second, while one meters per second equals 3.6 kilometers per hour. Whether you are verifying specifications on technical drawings, reconciling international supplier data sheets, or checking everyday measurements, this calculator applies the exact NIST and BIPM conversion factor with instant table lookups and step-by-step worked examples.

faqs.question: How many meters per second are in 1 kilometers per hour?
faqs.answer: There are 0.27778 meters per second (m/s) in 1 kilometers per hour (km/h). To convert km/h to m/s, use the exact conversion factor 0.27778.

faqs.question: How do I convert kilometers per hour to meters per second manually?
faqs.answer: Multiply your kilometers per hour value by 0.27778 (exact factor: 0.27778). For example, 50 km/h × 0.27778 = 13.88889 m/s.

faqs.question: What is 80 km/h in m/s?
faqs.answer: 80 kilometers per hour (km/h) equals 22.22222 meters per second (m/s).
